extends.compatibility: Requests without requested.loras keep their existing workflow, output identity and behavior.

healthCapability.meaning: Advertise only when the pinned code extension is installed. A passive check never mounts, wakes or starts a runtime.

request.directory: Canonical local Windows drive directory; no links, junctions, UNC paths or traversal.
request.fileName: Single safetensors filename, at most 240 code units.
request.sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; immutable content identity.
request.strength: Finite nonzero number from -2 through 2 inclusive. UI strength zero and unchecked rows are omitted.
request.duplicates: Duplicate content hashes are rejected. Order is preserved.
request.unknownFields: Reject within the versioned LoRA entry and requested settings, without rewriting existing state.

execution.loading: Apply all enabled model-only adapters in listed order. Validate tensor keys and dimensions against the exact loaded H3 model; reject unsupported or partly applied adapters. Never silently generate without selected adapters.
execution.formats: Native mapped linear up/down or PEFT A/B safetensors pairs with optional scalar alpha.
execution.staging: Bounded per-job temporary copies; original LoRA files are not moved or rewritten. Check free space, verify hashes again before loading, hold read locks while in use, and clean only after exact child exit.
execution.storage: Share existing core model files. Code extensions have independent immutable pins and a 4 MiB maximum; no duplicate model environment.
execution.recovery: Preserve selected order, strength and hashes in job snapshots. Missing or changed files fail explicitly. Never substitute a similarly named LoRA.
execution.limits: Count and byte bounds are resource safeguards, not a guarantee that all combinations fit GPU memory.
